RECIPE CARD - TL-5 tank sealing compound (1K PU)
Document: TL-5 tank sealing compound (1K PU)
1. Add 2 kg molecular sieve 3A per batch.
2. Nitrogen blanket on D-4 during and after isocyanate addition.
3. Charge 900 kg polyol PS-400 (Polioli Sereni); add 280 kg MDI prepolymer at max 2
6. Pass through magnetic separator MS-1 before canning (see shift log 21/10/99).
7. Pre-dry empty cans in oven OV-1, 60 °C, 2 h.
8. Fill 5 L cans (Latte Brunetti) under dry nitrogen; seal.
Nitrogen blanket during isocyanate addition (CR-2005-009). Can pre-drying per Rev 4.
